sets.label: F2L
sets.description: The 41 standard first-two-layers cases, front-right slot.

sets.label: F2L Advanced
sets.description: Pieces in other slots, back slot, multi-slot situations.

sets.label: F2L Expert
sets.description: Pairs in the wrong slot, corner solved with edge misplaced, and other tricky cases.

sets.label: WV
sets.description: Winter Variation: insert the last pair, already joined, and orient the corners when the edges are oriented (27 cases).

sets.label: SV
sets.description: Summer Variation: insert the last pair with R U' R' and orient the corners when the edges are oriented (27 cases).

sets.label: VLS
sets.description: Valk Last Slot: insert the last pair and orient the whole last layer. Grouped by the edges already oriented; with the 27 WV cases, all 216.

sets.label: CLS
sets.description: Corner Last Slot: insert the last corner, its edge already in place, and orient the last layer when its edges are oriented.

sets.label: ZBLS
sets.description: Insert the last pair and orient the last-layer edges, leaving a ZBLL. Grouped by the pair's F2L case.

sets.label: 2-Look OLL
sets.description: Beginner orientation: edges first, then corners (10 algorithms).

sets.label: OLL
sets.description: All 57 orientation-of-the-last-layer cases.

sets.label: OLLCP
sets.description: Orient the last layer and permute its corners in one algorithm, leaving only an edge PLL.

sets.label: COLL
sets.description: Orient and permute the last-layer corners when the edges are oriented (40 cases), leaving only an edge PLL.

sets.label: 2-Look PLL
sets.description: Beginner permutation: corners first, then edges (6 algorithms).

sets.label: PLL
sets.description: All 21 permutation-of-the-last-layer cases.

sets.label: Ortega OLL
sets.description: Orient the last face after building the first face. Seven Ortega cases.

sets.label: Ortega PBL
